# Ronning Systems, LLC

> Technology consultancy and the company behind Joblign — a job application tracking system with AI-powered resume generation and ATS analysis. Based in the Portland, OR metro area and founded by Patrick Ronning.

Ronning Systems builds Joblign ("Get aligned for success") and provides fractional CTO, project execution, and board & technical advisory services. Past work spans medical devices (BrightInsight, Oregon State Hospital), aerospace (Virgin Orbit), and wearables (Garmin).
